title: Extract a shared FakeFirestoreGateway test helper instead of re-implementing FirestoreGateway in 23 test files

evidence.quote: // W6.13: fetchAuditLogEntries added to FirestoreGateway interface.

why: `grep -rl "implements FirestoreGateway" test/` finds 23 files, of which this ~370-line _ToggleableFakeGateway is one; the other 22 are independent hand-rolled implementations of the same 25+-method interface. This file's own accretion comments ('Step 1 additions', 'W6.13', 'T1.gateway — stub') show the interface has grown at least 3 times since this fake was written — each growth requires editing every one of the 23 fakes or the analyzer fails each independently (classic shotgun surgery). This is also the single largest contributor to the file's AG-3 overage (see the paired finding).
recommendation: Extract one canonical InMemoryFirestoreGateway/FakeFirestoreGateway to test/helpers/, parameterized for online/offline + failure-injection behaviour used here, and have call sites configure it instead of re-implementing the interface.
acceptance_criteria: A shared fake gateway exists under test/helpers/ implementing FirestoreGateway once.
This file's _ToggleableFakeGateway is replaced by (or extends) the shared fake; repo-wide count of independent `implements FirestoreGateway` fakes decreases.
